description.value: Ladner Leisure Centre is a City of Delta-operated municipal recreation facility in the Ladner neighbourhood, with swimming as its primary programmed sport. It occupies a purpose-built recreation building on Clarence Taylor Crescent and functions as a community hub for fitness and aquatic programming for Delta residents.
